pages.quiz:
PHYSICS — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #12
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: PHYSICS
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Photosynthesis mainly produces: (1 mark)
   A. Glucose and oxygen
   B. Only water vapour
   C. Only carbon dioxide
   D. Nitrogen gas only

2. In a food chain, green plants are usually: (1 mark)
   A. Primary consumers only
   B. Tertiary consumers
   C. Decomposers only
   D. Producers

3. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Electromagnetic induction? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Electromagnetic induction.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Electromagnetic induction.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Electromagnetic induction.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Electromagnetic induction.

4. The SI unit of force is the: (1 mark)
   A. newton (N)
   B. watt (W)
   C. joule (J)
   D. pascal (Pa)

5. Which change is a physical change? (1 mark)
   A. Ice melting to water
   B. Milk souring
   C. Paper burning to ash
   D. Iron rusting

6. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Quantity of Heat? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Quantity of Heat.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Quantity of Heat.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Quantity of Heat.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Quantity of Heat.

7. A compound differs from a mixture because: (1 mark)
   A. A mixture always has a fixed melting point
   B. A compound can be separated by filtering only
   C. Mixtures cannot exist in Kenya
   D. Elements in a compound are chemically combined in a fixed ratio

8. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Introduction to Satellites? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Introduction to Satellites.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Introduction to Satellites.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Introduction to Satellites.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Introduction to Satellites.

9. Boiling point of pure water at standard pressure is about: (1 mark)
   A. 37 °C
   B. 0 °C
   C. 100 °C
   D. 50 °C

10. Diffusion is best described as: (1 mark)
   A. Heating until a solid melts
   B. A chemical reaction forming ash
   C. Net movement of particles from high to low concentration
   D. Movement of water only across a membrane

11. Why is water unsuitable for a petrol fire? (1 mark)
   A. Water can spread burning petrol instead of putting it out safely
   B. Water always increases oxygen
   C. Petrol fires have no fuel
   D. Water removes heat too quickly

12. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Thin lenses? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Thin lenses.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Thin lenses.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Thin lenses.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Thin lenses.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Quantity of Heat and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Thin lenses and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Photoelectric effect and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Electromagnetic induction and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
pages.answers:
MARKING SCHEME
====

1. A — Glucose and oxygen

2. D — Producers

3. B — Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Electromagnetic induction.

4. A — newton (N)

5. A — Ice melting to water

6. D — Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Quantity of Heat.

7. D — Elements in a compound are chemically combined in a fixed ratio

8. A — Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Introduction to Satellites.

9. C — 100 °C

10. C — Net movement of particles from high to low concentration

11. A — Water can spread burning petrol instead of putting it out safely

12. C — Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Thin lenses.

13. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Quantity of Heat; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

14. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Thin lenses; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

15. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Photoelectric effect; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

16. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Electromagnetic induction; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.
